Topology.title: Resilient Branch Office Network
Topology.Description: Design for a branch office with redundant routers, MPLS WAN connectivity, and survivable voice capabilities.
Topology.Summary: The branch office will have redundant routers connected via MPLS to the main data center. It will also have direct connections to the PSTN and a SIP provider for survivable voice functionality.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n21) in the 'Asset Management' zone (z7), which is connected to the primary and secondary routers (n1, n2). This suggests that an asset inventory system is in place and maintained.

Control.title: Document Data Flows
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n22) in the 'Asset Management' zone (z7), which is connected to the primary and secondary routers (n1, n2). This suggests that data flow documentation is in place and maintained.

Control.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
Control.Evidence: The topology includes multiple zones such as 'Data Center' (z2), 'Management Zone' (z3), 'Security Zone' (z4), and 'Non-Production Zone' (z5), which suggests that data processing and storage are segmented based on sensitivity.

Control.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Firewall' (n9) in the 'Security Zone' (z4), which is connected to both the primary and secondary routers (n1, n2). This suggests that a firewall is implemented and managed on the network.

Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n10) in the 'Security Zone' (z4), which is connected to both the primary and secondary routers (n1, n2). This suggests that trusted DNS servers are configured on enterprise assets.
